title: 15 Hair Salon Advertising Ideas to Get More Clients (2026)

facts.fact: The page presents a simple 30-day salon advertising plan with weekly steps.

The page's budget guidance for a salon with a budget close to $0 is to start with the Google Business Profile, reviews, service descriptions and portfolio, since these require time more than media spend.

facts.fact: The page advises judging a Google Search Ads test by search terms, qualified calls or forms, completed consultations and booked appointments rather than by clicks alone.
facts.quote: Do not judge the test by clicks alone.
